## How to read this

The evidence is a text search for the requirement ID (HLD documents excluding gate-review audits, LLD companions excluding gate-review, firmware and test sources). "Test cases" lists TC-... IDs that appear on the same line as the requirement ID; it does not prove a test passed - the LLD result tables do. **"No reference" means no document or source names the ID, not that the feature is missing**: a requirement can be implemented and simply never cited. Each such row needs a human decision: add the citation, or record the gap.
